dogecoin.text: I think memes today are more topical and relevant - they are about current affairs/events such as covid or dogecoin. The meme culture also has many subcultures of different communities and interests now. In that way, there is a higher variety of memes. #315WeekFour

I believe the individual is important in the spread of viral content online especially if the individual is influential or has a huge following. For example, I truly believe Elon Musk had a huge role to play in the viral dogecoin memes.  #315WeekFour
